slides.title: Title Slide
slides.bodyText:
VELORA-301 Phase III: Veloricept + Pembrolizumab in First-Line Advanced NSCLC
Primary PFS Results — ESMO 2026
slides.speakerNotes: Opening slide. Present at ESMO Congress 2026, Berlin. Data cut: 14 Aug 2026.

slides.title: Key Message 1 — Primary PFS Result
slides.bodyText: Veloricept + pembrolizumab demonstrated statistically significant improvement in PFS vs pembrolizumab alone (HR 0.61; 95% CI 0.48–0.77; p<0.001).
slides.speakerNotes: Emphasise the strength of the primary endpoint. Note interaction p-values for subgroups are non-significant.

slides.title: Methods Overview
slides.bodyText: Phase III, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial. n=487 patients. First-line advanced NSCLC. ECOG PS 0–2. Any PD-L1 expression.
slides.speakerNotes: Briefly cover inclusion criteria. Audience is familiar with the design from prior presentations.

slides.title: Results — PFS Kaplan-Meier
slides.bodyText: Median PFS: 14.2 months (veloricept arm) vs 8.7 months (pembrolizumab alone). HR 0.61 (95% CI 0.48–0.77; p<0.001).

figures.altText: Kaplan-Meier curve showing progression-free survival probability over time for veloricept plus pembrolizumab versus pembrolizumab alone. Median PFS 14.2 months versus 8.7 months.

slides.speakerNotes: Point to the separation of curves at Month 4 and the sustained benefit through Month 18.

slides.title: Results — Subgroup Consistency
slides.bodyText: Consistent benefit across PD-L1 expression levels and histology subgroups. All interaction p-values non-significant.

figures.altText: Forest plot showing hazard ratios for progression-free survival across pre-specified subgroups including PD-L1 CPS threshold and tumour histology.

slides.speakerNotes: Key point: no differential benefit by PD-L1 threshold. Supports a broad label.

slides.title: Safety Summary
slides.bodyText: Grade 3+ TRAEs: 52% vs 44%. No new safety signals. Safety profile consistent with known profiles of each agent.
slides.speakerNotes: Note grade 3+ pneumonitis 8% in veloricept arm. Standard management protocols apply.
